in_marathi.name: Lohit
in_marathi.long_meaning: Lohit हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Lohit is derived from the Sanskrit language. It is associated with the color red and crimson. In Hindu mythology, Lohit is the name of a demon or asura who is the god of fire and has the power to grant boons. He is also known as Agni, the god of fire.
